Body.Content:
GitHub Codespaces, a cloud-based development environment, is now available to all GitHub Teams and GitHub Enterprise Cloud customers. Codespaces provides full development environments with up to 32 cores, that can be accessed from a web browser, Visual Studio Code, or using SSH.

Visit GitHub Codespaces.
